constraints: 1..5607 lines, each with exactly two integers weight and strength in 1..200000, read until end of file.
Strength includes the turtle's own weight; weights and strengths may repeat.
independentMethod: Quadratic DP over turtles sorted by strength where best[k] is the lightest valid k-turtle stack; unit tests compare against exhaustive ordered-subset search for up to six turtles.

mutations.label: Sorts by remaining capacity instead of strength
mutations.replace: sort(turtles.begin(), turtles.end(), [](const pair<long long, long long> &x, const pair<long long, long long> &y) { return x.first - x.second < y.first - y.second; });

mutations.label: Lets strength exclude the turtle's own weight
Drops the new turtle instead of the heaviest one
